raw: {"status": "NO_PLAN", "reasons": ["CS3241 is only offered in Sem 1. To take CS3247 (Sem 2), CS3241 must be taken in an odd semester. The earliest odd semester after Y1 is Sem 3. However, Sem 3 has a limit of 4 modules. The prerequisites for the earliest possible Sem 4 courses (CS4430, CS2106, CS2101, CS3219) are CS3231, CS2100, CS3230, CS3241, and CS2103T. CS2109S must be taken with CS2103T. This requires 5 slots in Sem 3 (CS2109S, CS2103T, CS3231, CS2100, CS3230, CS3241) but only 4 are available. Specifically, CS3241 cannot be taken in Sem 3 if we also need CS3231, CS2100, and CS2103T/CS2109S to enable Sem 4 courses, because CS3241 is needed for CS3247 which is a required module. If CS3241 is delayed to Sem 5, CS3247 is delayed to Sem 6. This pushes the schedule. More critically, CS3230 must be before CS2106 and CS2101. CS3230 is offered Sem 1. If CS3230 is taken in Sem 3, CS2106/CS2101 can be Sem 4. But we cannot fit all prerequisites in Sem 3. If we delay CS3230 to Sem 5, CS2106/CS2101 are delayed to Sem 6. The constraint of fitting all necessary prerequisites into Sem 3 (4 slots) while also taking CS2109S+CS2103T (2 slots) and CS3241 (1 slot, needed for CS3247) and CS3231/CS2100/CS3230 (3 slots) is impossible. We have 6 prerequisite courses (CS2109S, CS2103T, CS3241, CS3231, CS2100, CS3230) that ideally should be taken in Sem 3 to allow Sem 4 courses, but we only have 4 slots. Even if we drop CS3241 from Sem 3, we still have 5 courses for 4 slots. Thus, no valid plan exists that satisfies all prerequisites and semester limits."}
